payroll.v.max_lines: A wage sheet can have at most 500 lines
payroll.v.national_id_format: National ID must be exactly 16 digits
payroll.v.wage_positive: Daily wage must be more than 0
payroll.v.end_before_start: End date must be on or after the start date
payroll.v.max_31_days: A wage sheet can cover at most 31 days
payroll.v.days_half: Days must be in half days (e.g. 9.5)
payroll.v.food_whole: Food deduction must be whole francs
payroll.v.other_whole: Other deduction must be whole francs
payroll.err.nid_taken: National ID {id} is already registered to {who}
payroll.err.period_exists: A wage sheet for {plant} {range} already exists ({number})
payroll.err.not_draft: Only draft wage sheets can be edited. Ask a reviewer to return it to draft first.
payroll.err.once_only: Each worker can appear only once
payroll.err.dup_worker: This worker appears twice on the sheet
payroll.err.worker_inactive: {name} is inactive; reactivate the worker first
payroll.err.days_exceed: {name}: at most {max} days in this period
payroll.err.days_step: {name}: days must be 0 or more in half days
payroll.err.submitted_meanwhile: This wage sheet was submitted by someone else in the meantime. Reload to see its current state.
payroll.err.changed_meanwhile: This wage sheet was changed by someone else in the meantime. Reload and try again.
payroll.err.empty_prepare: Record days worked for at least one worker before marking the sheet as prepared
payroll.err.state_mismatch: This wage sheet is {current}; it must be {required} to {verb} it
payroll.err.return_state: Only prepared, checked or verified wage sheets can be returned to draft (this one is {current})
payroll.err.no_petty_perm: You do not have permission to record petty cash entries
payroll.err.refs_mismatch: Payment references do not match this wage sheet
payroll.err.ref_line: This line is not on the wage sheet
payroll.sod.prepare_check: Separation of duties: you prepared this wage sheet, so a different person must check it
payroll.sod.prepare_verify: Separation of duties: you prepared this wage sheet, so a different person must verify it
payroll.sod.prepare_authorize: Separation of duties: you prepared this wage sheet, so a different person must authorize it
payroll.sod.check_verify: Separation of duties: you checked this wage sheet, so a different person must verify it
payroll.sod.check_authorize: Separation of duties: you checked this wage sheet, so a different person must authorize it
payroll.sod.verify_authorize: Separation of duties: you verified this wage sheet, so a different person must authorize it
payroll.warn.petty_overdraw: Recording these wages takes the approved petty cash balance to {balance}. Record a float deposit to cover it.
payroll.pdf.draft_banner: DRAFT — NOT AUTHORIZED FOR PAYMENT. Do not pay from this copy.
payroll.pdf.empty: No days recorded on this wage sheet.
payroll.pdf.wages_to_pay: Wages to pay: {net} · {workers}, {days} days · total wages {gross} less deductions {deductions}
payroll.pdf.omitted_one: {n} registered worker with no days in this period is not listed.
payroll.pdf.omitted_many: {n} registered workers with no days in this period are not listed.
payroll.pdf.mismatch_note: * MoMo account name differs from the worker's ID name ({n}). Confirm the account holder before paying — wages may be going to someone else.
payroll.pdf.empty_range: No wage sheets overlap this range.
payroll.pdf.summary_note: Whole wage sheets are counted when any of their days fall in the range; figures are not pro-rated. Amounts in RWF. Average daily wage = gross wages ÷ days worked.
payroll.pdf.summary_draft_note: Sheets not yet authorized are included and their figures may still change.
payroll.err.negative_lines: {n} lines have a negative amount to pay. Correct the deductions before preparing
payroll.err.override_reason: {name}: the system calculated {days} days and {hours} overtime hours. Give a reason for changing them
payroll.notify.step_body: Wage sheet {number} ({plant}, {workers} workers, {net}) was moved on by {by}
payroll.notify.step_title.check: Wage sheet waiting for your check
notify.event.payroll.step_pending: Wage sheet waiting for your step
notify.event.payroll.step_pending.help: A wage sheet reached the approval step you are responsible for
notify.event.payroll.paid.help: A wage sheet was paid and the payments were recorded
payroll.pdf.formula: Wage = days × daily rate + half days × half-day rate + overtime hours × overtime rate + piece-work + adjustments. Rates come from the approved rate rules in force on each day. † = manual override (reason below)
payroll.v.overtime: Overtime hours must be 0 or more, in quarter hours
payroll.v.paid_future: The payment date cannot be in the future
payroll.v.rate_basis: Choose daily, piece rate or mixed
